reason: I'd take the free fee check and the 60-day trial because I keep my old system and terminal, so I lose nothing, and if my fees aren't lower after 90 days the plan is free. $39 is fine if it really beats what I pay now.
objection: What happens when the internet goes down on a busy Saturday? Nothing here says it keeps working offline, and I'm not putting my Saturday on something that stops taking payments.
would_change_my_mind: Show me in writing, or let me call a salon already running it, that tickets and payments keep working when the internet drops and sync later.
